name: legal-expert
description: Research Romanian law, manage subscribed document libraries, run legal analysis, OCR and comparison workflows, and build auditable Excel tables.

interface.shortDescription: Legal research, analysis, OCR, comparison, and Excel.
interface.longDescription: Helps Romanian legal professionals research LawDB and Legalpedia, manage document bundles, run Legal Expert's legal-review, OCR, contract-changes and signed-copy verification agents, review extracted events, configure notifications, and turn document sets into auditable Excel workbooks. Subscriber and tenant access is enforced by Legal Expert.
defaultPrompt: Analyze these legal documents and preserve source evidence.
Build an auditable Excel matrix from this document set.
